name: mirofish
description: MiroFish - A flexible collective-intelligence engine for forecasting complex scenarios

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../auth-service && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.dev: npm run auth:prepare && concurrently --kill-others -n "backend,frontend,auth" -c "green,cyan,magenta" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend" "npm run auth"
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
